articles.title: Saka injury 'does not look good' - how will Arsenal cope?
articles.summary: Mikel Arteta says the quadriceps injury Arsenal's Bukayo Saka picked up in the Champions League draw with Bayern Munich "does not look good at all".

articles.title: Animal rights group asks Crystal Palace to retire eagle mascot
articles.summary: Animal rights group Peta is urging Crystal Palace to retire their bald eagle mascot, saying a "bright stadium filled with boisterous fans is no place for animals".

articles.title: Conan, Doris, Crowley absent from Ireland's Nations Championship squad
articles.summary: Andy Farrell's Ireland will head into November's Nations Championship without injured trio Jack Conan, Caelan Doris and Jack Crowley, but Jamison Gibson-Park has been included.
